components.name: Trivia Option Card
components.description: Interactive multiple-choice option card with frosted glass styling and gold borders.
components.css: .dbara-option-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; background: rgba(19, 28, 46, 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(229, 169, 59, 0.18); border-radius: 16px; color: #F8FAFC; font-family: Rubik, sans-serif; font-size: 1.1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); text-align: right; direction: rtl; } .dbara-option-btn:hover { border-color: #E5A93B; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(229, 169, 59, 0.15); } .dbara-option-idx { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(229, 169, 59, 0.12); color: #E5A93B; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: A luxury, modern Libyan Neo-Heritage design system uniting deep obsidian glassmorphism, Sahara Gold accents, Mediterranean teal and emerald tones, and crisp Arabic typography.

rules.name: The Gold Rarity Rule
rules.body: Sahara Gold is reserved for items of true value (rewards, stars, primary CTAs) and never used on large text or neutral backgrounds.

rules.name: The Arabic Leading Rule
rules.body: Line heights for Arabic body and question texts are increased by at least 15% to accommodate diacritics and ascending characters.

dos: Use crisp Rubik and Cairo typography with RTL direction.
Ensure all touch targets are at least 48x48px with generous spacing.
Implement instant Web Audio synthesizer feedback for correct/incorrect answers.
donts: Never use gradient text for question titles.
Do not use generic emojis in place of styled SVG icons.
Avoid harsh opaque card borders or generic gray placeholder styling.
